name: Order Form (Opportunity)
summary: Order Form generated from an Opportunity: customer and entity from the Account, a line-item table from Opportunity Products with discounted lines marked, and clauses that switch on deal type, deal size, special terms and personal data.
description: Fontara Order Form from an Opportunity and its products. Built from assets/salesforce-gen-templates/specs/order-form-opportunity.json.

body.p: This Order Form is entered into between **{{Account.Fontara_Entity__c}}** ("Fontara") and **{{Account.Name}}** ("Customer") under the Master Subscription Agreement between them. The products and fees below apply from the order date.

then.p: Fontara will schedule the implementation kickoff within ten business days of the order date and assign a named onboarding manager.

else.p: This order continues Customer's existing subscription without interruption. Fees below replace the fees of the prior order from the order date.

body.p: "Your price" is shown only on discounted lines; other lines are at list price.

then.p: The discounted prices above are valid only if Customer signs this Order Form on or before {{CloseDate}}. Discounts do not carry over to renewals unless a later order says so.
**Volume commitment.** Because the order total is at least $250,000, Customer's fees are fixed for the first twelve months and Fontara grants one additional sandbox environment at no charge.
The parties agreed the following terms, which prevail over the Master Subscription Agreement for this order only: {{Description?}}
**Personal data.** Fontara processes personal data under this order only as Customer's processor and under the Data Processing Agreement between the parties.

body.p: Fontara invoices annually in advance. Invoices are due thirty days after the invoice date.
